status: Blockout integrated and compared at normal World camera. Approved for detail with recorded geometry corrections.

projection.calibration: Use camera target/shift so chosen courtyard ground origin projects to [640,600] logical. Derive and report projected basis vectors using world_to_camera_view. Existing 2:1 route axes must align.

composition.ambientCrew: inspect basePatrol world paths; keep forward ground clear
composition.bridgeDeckHeightNote: Road and bridge deck meet same projected z=0 ground plane at named sockets; sea below by substantial cliff elevation. Inlet under bridge with near/far abutments; terrain spur at join. Preserve x/y project positions.
composition.routeWidthNote: Widen hero crossing/approach to42 logical px for normal-scale legibility; taper far-end to existing26.4-width junction in last70logical px. Keep sockets fixed.
composition.courtFeedback: Widen loading court/asymmetric service apron; keep all worker points and patrol clear. Fix coplanar road/court overlap. Model modular edge/drains/curbs and a few static service props outside patrol, no baked task cargo.
composition.terrainFeedback: Keep main left silhouette within-540 to avoid excess normal-camera clipping; jagged cliff faces/strata, interrupted terraces/sheltered coves, less uninterrupted empty plateau. Reference material organic density, not simple extruded rings.

placement.consumer: World cinematic featured exterior only, keep HQ/Watch current
placement.variableLayout: Builder replaces only matching real route section; separate bridge layer may be omitted for other route geometry. Never create a phantom project connection.

layers.purpose: terrain-derived submerged water colour/depth, transparent outside coverage, no arbitrary rectangle edges
terraces cliffs ground roads/court, with base contact shadows; no architecture/bridge in this layer
articulated base behind open live court, transparent everywhere else
elevated connected deck rails supports abutments; separate from terrain
only necessary foreground occlusion; keep worker court unobstructed
registered practical emission only, day/night controlled

masks.shore: registered straight-alpha RGBA; red channel encodes normalized offshore distance 0 at rocks to 1 outer surf extent; alpha encodes water visibility excluding land/supports. No baked white outline
masks.depth: registered RGBA; R water depth (0 shallow,1 deep), alpha water coverage. Can combine with shore channels if producer documents exact encoding.
masks.foam: Builder uses shore distance and coverage to animate crest advancing/receding without translating mask

export.alpha: straight RGBA PNG transparent, no matte
export.metadata: entries.json each asset id/file/sourceSize/logicalSize/groundAnchor/sha256/bytes/boundsSourcePixels/sockets; all hashes measured
export.source: source Blender/scripts + assembled blockout.png before material detail + final assembled preview + measurement json
export.light: compatible upper-left warm daylight with cool ambient; report actual Blender area-light transform
export.workers: No baked robots, labels, task state, artifacts or semantic lights
